snapshot.title: Sketch star map UI for target selection
snapshot.description: The launchpad target selector currently shows a card list. Sketch an alternative star-map style target picker: candidates placed roughly at their sky coordinates, distance/fuel indicator when selecting a target, planet vs asteroid visual distinction, how TESS candidate data shows (magnitude, distance, disposition). This is a rough concept sketch — not a final design.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Key data points identified for each target type
